title: Constitutional Reconciliation / Minimum Delta

historical_lineage.rule: Historical 110/110/26 remains immutable provenance and is not rewritten.

new_requirements.responsibility: Maintain a versioned LearnerModelProjection that synthesizes owner-valid learner state without becoming a second writer of source truth.
Record append-oriented self-regulation observations for plan, monitor, evaluate and strategy-use state without converting them into competence.

Preserve bounded intentionally supplied motivation, effort, task-value and confusion context as non-diagnostic learner context; missing context is not negative and context is never direct mastery evidence.

Preserve materially relevant assistance condition on learning evidence, including independent, instructional-scaffold, AI-assisted, collaborative, authorized-accommodation, tool-permitted and unknown-assistance standing.

Require owner-valid independent-performance or support-withdrawal verification when the intended construct requires independence, without withdrawing required accommodations or rewriting prior assisted evidence.
Define and interpret versioned educational-effectiveness evaluations while shared Assurance/Analytics retains generic experiment and statistical machinery.

Own the Learning-system obligation to provide version-pinned CASE, QTI, Caliper and CLR adapter mappings while preserving Learning/Curriculum semantic owners and shared Integration/Gateway transport; no external standard becomes canonical Learning truth.

Own fail-closed handling of imported non-authoritative competency-alignment proposals/associations with provenance while leaving authoritative equivalence with the unresolved future alignment owner under LRN-069 / LRN-EXT-002.

new_interfaces.name: GetLearnerModelProjection
new_interfaces.rule: Read-only version/as-of projection; no hidden source mutation.

new_interfaces.name: RecordSelfRegulationObservation
new_interfaces.rule: Append-oriented, semantically idempotent, bounded learner-declared/context observation; never direct mastery mutation.

new_interfaces.name: RegisterLearningEffectivenessEvaluation
new_interfaces.rule: Registers the Learning-specific protocol/claim subject and exact version pins; generic assignment/statistics remain shared Assurance/Analytics authority.

new_interfaces.name: GetLearningEffectivenessEvaluation
new_interfaces.rule: Returns bounded evaluation standing, evidence references, uncertainty, limitations and intended-use claim; never rewrites mastery or creates product-wide effectiveness truth.

new_semantic_objects.name: LearnerModelProjection
new_semantic_objects.source_truth: References existing owner-valid goal, observation, assessment, evidence, mastery, retention, transfer, remediation, maintenance, SRL and assistance-condition state.

new_semantic_objects.name: SelfRegulationObservation
new_semantic_objects.relationship: LRN-E017 SelfConfidenceObservation remains valid and may be projected as one bounded SRL signal rather than being superseded.

new_semantic_objects.name: LearningEffectivenessEvaluationDescriptor
new_semantic_objects.scope: Learning-specific intervention, comparator, outcome, time horizon, assistance condition, evidence package, standing, uncertainty, limitations and intended-use claim.

existing_objects_extended.change: Make evidence coverage and uncertainty mandatory where applicable; represent retention, transfer and independence as explicit profile/gate/condition semantics; preserve contradictions and assistance standing.
Keep SelfConfidenceObservation; expose it as bounded learner self-report within the broader SRL projection without turning confidence into competence.
Extend InstructionalPolicyVersion for AI tutoring support ladder, direct-answer rules, scaffolding/fading, self-explanation, feedback timing and accommodation-safe behavior.

Extend AdaptiveLearningPolicyVersion to consume Learner Model, SRL, evidence uncertainty, retention, transfer and independence; eligibility precedes ranking and durable learning/independence outrank short-term performance.
Extend AdaptiveDecisionTrace with eligible-action set, exclusion reasons, reason codes, learner choice/override context, ranking inputs, deterministic fallback and exact policy/source versions.

existing_objects_extended.name: AssessmentAttempt existing Learning object
existing_objects_extended.change: Extend score/result semantics with assistance conditions, scorer/model/rubric versions, score standing, assurance references and human-review lineage; external/asynchronous score-commit ingress remains unresolved.
Allow CLR/QTI/other export-format references and exact adapter/profile/version provenance as subordinate packaging metadata without converting the descriptor into certification/eligibility authority.

existing_interfaces_extended.change: Carry the 001G uncertainty/coverage/retention/transfer/independence and assistance-condition semantics through existing evidence/mastery surfaces.
Carry 001H eligibility-before-ranking, learner choice/override, reason codes, deterministic fallback and shared model-assurance fencing through existing adaptation surfaces.
Retain SubmitSelfConfidence unchanged in authority; its output may feed LRN-E027 alongside LRN-E028 observations.
Carry exact interoperability/export provenance and external-record references without converting packaging or authorization into qualification/certification/eligibility truth.

subordinate_noncanonical_types.name: EvidenceAssistanceCondition
subordinate_noncanonical_types.reason: Required by 001G but does not need a standalone canonical entity/object ID.

subordinate_noncanonical_types.name: AdaptiveEligibilityReasonCode / AdaptiveSelectionReasonCode
subordinate_noncanonical_types.reason: Required for 001H explainability but belongs inside LRN-E021/I026 semantics rather than a new truth owner.

subordinate_noncanonical_types.name: AssessmentScoreStanding / ScorerLineage
subordinate_noncanonical_types.reason: Required by 001I but subordinate to AssessmentAttempt/result semantics and shared Assurance references.

subordinate_noncanonical_types.name: InteroperabilityEnvelope / MappingStanding
subordinate_noncanonical_types.reason: Required by 001K but remains adapter/provenance metadata rather than canonical Learning truth.

unchanged_authority_fences: LRN-069 / LRN-EXT-002 authoritative cross-domain competency equivalence remains unresolved and deny-by-default.
S04 external/asynchronous score-commit ingress remains unresolved and fail-closed; no callback authority is invented.

Learning does not own identity, generic artifact bytes, generic jobs/runtime, scheduler/delivery, transport, generic evidence/provenance substrate, rights/licensing, privacy/security authorization, generic model assurance/statistics, credential signing/serialization, certification, hiring, licensing or eligibility decisions.
Curriculum remains an internal Learning-system truth boundary, not a Topology peer.
Observation, completion, score, confidence, engagement, accepted AI output and generic productivity do not directly establish mastery.
Authorized accommodation does not automatically invalidate evidence and is not withdrawn merely to manufacture independence.
External standards remain adapters, never canonical semantic owners.
removed_or_not_admitted: Task completion/output quality/accepted AI answer/generic productivity as direct mastery evidence.
Automated inferred emotion or mental-state truth from raw chat/device/camera/voice/physiological telemetry as a default Learning capability.
A separate AI Tutor semantic owner.
A second mastery writer, learner-model source writer, assessment writer, statistics platform, integration platform or credential authority inside Learning.

implementation_slices.name: Tutoring + adaptive runtime expansion
implementation_slices.scope: Implement 001F/001H policy semantics on LRN-E020-C, LRN-E020-L, LRN-E021 and existing action interfaces.

implementation_slices.name: Assessment/model-governance hardening
implementation_slices.scope: Implement score standing/scorer lineage/shared-Assurance fences without inventing external score ingress.

implementation_slices.name: Learning-effectiveness evaluation runtime
implementation_slices.scope: Implement LRN-E029/I113/I114 over shared Assurance/Analytics/Evidence infrastructure.

implementation_slices.scope: Run the applicable frozen 001D-001K contracts and regression suites on the exact changed implementation subject; preserve software qualification separately from psychometric/educational-effectiveness claims.
